_comment: Reviewed high/critical dependency advisories, consumed by scripts/audit-ratchet.mjs.
An advisory not listed here fails Security; a listed advisory that disappears also fails so the baseline can only shrink.

accepted.name: @expo/cli
accepted.reason: Upstream GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv in node-forge <= 1.4.0; build/signing tooling only; unblocks on upstream Expo/node-forge patch.

accepted.name: @expo/code-signing-certificates
accepted.reason: Upstream GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv in node-forge <= 1.4.0; build/signing tooling only; unblocks on upstream Expo/node-forge patch.

accepted.name: expo
accepted.reason: Upstream GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm in braces <= 3.0.3 within Metro dev tooling; static production export unaffected; unblocks on upstream Expo/Metro patch.

accepted.name: node-forge
accepted.reason: Upstream GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv in node-forge <= 1.4.0; build/signing tooling only; unblocks on upstream Expo/node-forge patch.

accepted.name: zod
accepted.reason: GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 in zod <4.6.6; Expo CLI pins zod ^3.25.76 and the newest @expo/cli (58.1.15) still does, so no upstream fix exists. The copy is build/CI tooling of @expo/cli only — it never validates a user-supplied collection, so the oversized-collection DoS it describes is not reachable here; unblocks on an upstream Expo zod bump.
